component.name: Obtura
component.summary: Capture, annotate, redact and record your screen

description.p: Obtura is a screenshot and screen recording tool for the GNOME desktop, with an editor that needs no manual. Everything happens on your computer: Obtura never connects to the internet.

ul.li: Capture a region or the whole screen, the same region again, after a delay, or a whole page that scrolls; the picture is on the clipboard at once

Annotate: arrows, curves through several points, shapes, pen, highlighter, text and callouts typed on the picture in any installed font, numbered steps, emoji and symbols, magnifier, spotlight, measure. Every mark stays editable, and can be turned, until you save
Beautify: background colours or a picture of your own, padding, rounded corners, shadow, window bar, phone, tablet, laptop and monitor frames
Edit the picture: crop, rotate, resize, add space, cut out a strip, combine several pictures
Copy the text of a picture or of any part of the screen, read QR codes, pick a colour, measure the screen, pin a picture on the screen

Record the screen, an area, a window or all your screens as MP4, WebM or GIF, with microphone and computer sound (with level meters); pause, resume and stop from Obtura's icon in the top bar; trim afterwards
A library of every capture, searchable by the text in it and by your own tags
A command line for scripts and keyboard shortcuts

screenshot.caption: The editor: arrows, text, numbered steps and a blurred email address
Beautify: background, shadow and window bar in one click
Smart Redact finds what should not be shared
Recording the screen as MP4, WebM or GIF

ul.li: Obtura now also runs on Windows 10 and 11: an installer and a zip to run without installing; Print Screen captures a region from any app, and Obtura's icon by the clock offers the other captures. Everything but screen recording.
A mark below a blur, pixelate, box or magnifier shows its new shape at once when it is resized, turned or bent (the saved picture was already right)
Windows: in Formatting and Beautify, one click in the colour chooser picks the colour (the first click used to close the panel only)
Windows: Obtura no longer stops at start with some graphics drivers

description.p: The first package of Obtura, for Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and newer: the release candidate for 1.0.

ul.li: Scrolling capture: a whole page that scrolls in one picture

An editor whose marks stay editable and can be turned: lines and arrows, curves through several points, shapes, pen, highlighter, text in any installed font (paste text with Ctrl+V), callouts, numbered steps, emoji, spotlight, magnifier, blur, pixelate, box, crop, cut out, copy text, colour picker, measure
Smart Redact (QR codes too), Beautify (a picture as background, device frames), the Image menu (rotate, resize, add space, combine several pictures)
Read QR codes in a picture or on the screen; measure on the screen; colours copied as hex, rgb() or hsl()
Screen recording of an area, a screen, a window or all screens to MP4, WebM and GIF with sound and level meters, pause and resume from the top bar, and trimming
The library of every capture, searchable by its text and by tags (accents do not matter); pin to screen
Keys that work in every app: Super+Shift+S for a region, Super+Shift+T for text, Super+Shift+R to record
Help › User Guide (F1), a manual page (man obtura), and the licences of the software Obtura contains in the About window
A log file of errors and crashes, on your computer only (Show Log File)
